title: Derivative of an integral over a half-line
statement: If $f:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ is integrable and continuous, then for every $t\in\mathbb R$ the function $b\mapsto\int_{(-\infty,b]} f(x)\,dx$ has derivative $f(t)$ at $b=t$.
